text: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all maintenance plans. If you cancel within 14 days of signup, you get a full refund to your original payment method. After 14 days, plans are non-refundable but you can cancel any time and keep service until the end of the billing month. Custom development projects are refunded only for milestones not yet started.
title: Refund policy

text: Our support team works 3 PM to 1 AM IST, Monday to Saturday, which covers the US morning and the full European workday. Emergency bug fixes for hacked sites or downtime get a response within 4 hours, day or night. Regular tickets are answered within one business day.
title: Support hours

text: The WordPress care plan costs $49 per month per site. It includes weekly core, theme and plugin updates, daily cloud backups with one-click restore, uptime monitoring every 5 minutes, malware scanning and cleanup if your site gets hacked, and a monthly report of everything we did. Annual billing gives you two months free.
title: WordPress maintenance plan

text: A typical Laravel web application takes 6 to 10 weeks from kickoff to launch. Week 1 to 2 is discovery and database design, weeks 3 to 6 are API and backend development, weeks 7 to 8 are frontend integration and testing, and the final weeks are deployment and training. We deploy with zero-downtime releases and provide two weeks of free bug-fix support after launch.
title: Laravel project timeline

text: We accept payments through Stripe, which supports all major credit cards, and direct bank transfer for annual contracts. Invoices are issued on the 1st of each month and are due within 14 days. A 50 percent advance is required before custom development work begins, with the balance due at launch.
title: Payment methods

text: Onboarding takes about 3 business days. You share access to your hosting, domain registrar and WordPress admin, we run a full backup and security audit, then schedule a 30-minute kickoff call to agree on priorities. You get access to a shared Trello board where you can watch every task move from todo to done.
title: Client onboarding

text: Critical bugs that take your site offline are fixed within 4 hours. Major bugs that break important features like checkout or contact forms are fixed within 24 hours. Minor visual or content bugs are batched and fixed in the weekly maintenance window every Friday.
title: Bug fix turnaround
